recentEvents: Q3 2026 (23 Oct 2026): sales SEK 7,407m (+8.3%), organic +1.6%; EBITA 1,708m (+10.7%), margin 23.1% (22.6%); EPS 2.15 (1.96); op CF 1,662m (+19%). Sales 1.3% below consensus, adj EBITA 0.8% above.
A Systems Solutions (contract manufacturing) customer, ~5% of group revenue, will shift purchases outside Europe from Jan 2027; negative effect on 2027 sales and earnings.
Shares fell 12.0% on report day; after the report FactSet 2027 adj EBITA cut 3.8%, average target cut 8.6% to 332.36; consensus rating Overweight (5 positive, 5 neutral of 10).
Dental margin up; Demolition & Tools margin down on weak demolition robot demand. Micronova and Hega Medical to be consolidated in Q4.

Organic growth weak (Q3 +1.6%, 9M +2.5%); growth driven by acquisitions.
Leverage 1.6x incl. option liabilities (1.0x interest-bearing); slightly falling. Cash conversion improving, not weak.

valuation.method: Next-12m EPS x justified P/E per scenario. Basis 2026E EPS 8.6 = 9M 6.38 + Q4 about 2.2 (lead estimate). 2027 growth reduced for the lost 5% customer. Historical P/E range not verified by agents; justified multiples are lead estimates, not sourced.

bear.note: Customer loss plus weak organic growth; multiple compresses. Justified multiple 24x on next-12m 8.86.

base.note: Acquisitions offset lost customer; EBITA margin about 23%. Justified multiple 30x on next-12m 9.29.

bull.note: Acquisition pace rises, dental recovers. Justified multiple 35x on next-12m 9.55.

valuation.whyItFits: Decentralised acquirer with EBITA margin about 23%, ROIC about 20% and rising cash conversion; niche dental and tools businesses are resilient.
valuation.growthDrivers: Steady bolt-on acquisitions, dental consumables, demolition robots; reinvestment at high returns.
valuation.saturation: Trailing P/E 33 after a 12% drop on the Q3 report; still a premium multiple with estimates being cut.
valuation.principalRisk: Loss of a customer worth about 5% of sales from 2027 and estimate cuts (2027 EBITA -3.8%) while the multiple stays high.
